The season ran from August 17, 2001 to May 19, 2002.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg02.html Argentina 2001–02] by Javier Roimiser on RSSSF.com [[Racing Club de Avellaneda]] won the Apertura (its 16th league title, after 35 years with no domestic championships) and [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] the Clausura (32nd title) championships, while [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano (C)]] and [[Argentinos Juniors]] were relegated to the second division.
